title: GQE/QSCI circuits executed through NVIDIA CUDA-Q (qpp-cpu CPU backend)
method: UCCSD ansatz (cudaq.kernels.uccsd) evaluated via cudaq.observe (VQE) and sampled via cudaq.sample (QSCI determinant selection), both on CUDA-Q's qpp-cpu statevector backend. Interleaved spin-orbital ordering matches OpenFermion. Same SDK path that dispatches to cuStateVec/tensornet-mps on GPU; run on CPU here for third-party reproducibility.
honest_caveats: qpp-cpu is CUDA-Q's CPU statevector backend; this proves the circuits compile/execute through the SDK, NOT a GPU/MPS scaling run (still owed). It validates the execution layer, not 40q scale.
Small systems (H4/H6) where exact FCI is available, so the CUDA-Q result is fully validated.
VQE uses gradient-free COBYLA; QSCI diagonalizes H in the CUDA-Q-sampled determinant subspace.
